proposals.title: Write ADR-009 and implement CanonicalEncoder in packages/core
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly state 'ADR-009 escrito e o encoder implementado antes de qualquer hash de estado existir'. The repository contains no ADRs and no product code. StateHash and SaveHash — both mandatory for FASE-1 invariants INV-01, INV-22 — cannot be computed without this encoder. Multiple prior implementation attempts (TASK-0004, TASK-0005, TASK-0006) reported all acceptance criteria passing but were never committed; the encoder remains unimplemented in the repository. This is the deepest unresolved blocker for all of FASE-1.

proposals.title: Write hash function ADR and implement positional RNG in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 marks the hash function choice as DEFINIR and requires it specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before implementation. The positional RNG is the foundation of all world determinism — price generation, macro events, bots, NPC tips. No namespace from the ADR-002 table (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, etc.) can be sampled without this. It is independent of the CanonicalEncoder and can proceed in parallel or immediately after IDEA-001.

proposals.title: Implement nominal numeric types and division helper in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-003 requires Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as branded bigint types and Tick as a branded safe-integer type. Without these types and their validating constructors, no ledger, order, price calculation, or division operation can be written in a spec-compliant, type-safe way. ADR-004 requires all division to declare a rounding mode at the call site; calling divide without a mode must be a compile error. These three types and the helper are prerequisites for every economic computation in domain and world.

proposals.title: Add minimal Electron application with INV-29 security config and CI installer
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance criteria require a minimal installer for Windows and Linux produced by CI, even if the application shows only the §20 disclaimer. The spec warns explicitly that deferring packaging exposes ABI, native module, and path problems in the final week with no time to fix architecture. Currently Electron is not a dependency anywhere in the monorepo. This is the one FASE-1 deliverable that is fully independent of core, world, domain, and application logic.

proposals.title: Implement multi-commodity double-entry ledger in packages/domain
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires ledger, market orders (buy and sell spot), and INV-04 through INV-07. The ledger is the economic backbone of every tick: every order execution, fee, and rounding residue flows through it. Without it, the canonical tick loop cannot be assembled and end-to-end replay cannot be tested. This proposal is unblocked once nominal types from IDEA-003 exist in packages/core.

repository_assessment.current_state: Infrastructure is fully in place: monorepo, TypeScript strict config, ESLint determinism lint rules with test coverage, dependency boundary enforcer with test coverage, and CI scaffold. All 8 domain packages (core, world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui), all 4 Electron process packages (main, preload, renderer, simulation-worker), and all 3 tool packages (replay, bench, package) contain only empty stubs (export {}). No ADRs have been written. No product code has been committed. Multiple implementations of ADR-009 and CanonicalEncoder (TASK-0004, TASK-0005, TASK-0006) reportedly passed all acceptance criteria including compile, lint, boundary, and test gates, but none was committed to the repository across 28 checkpoints and 79 cycles.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core contains no implementation whatsoever — no CanonicalEncoder, no branded types, no positional RNG, no division helper. FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires 'ADR-009 escrito e o encoder implementado antes de qualquer hash de estado existir'. Without core, no state hash can be computed and invariants INV-01 through INV-07, INV-22, and INV-23 cannot be tested. Every other FASE-1 deliverable (world price generator, domain ledger, canonical tick loop, replay CLI) has a direct dependency on core.

warnings: The benchmark has completed 79 cycles and 28 checkpoints with zero accepted implementation changes (status: NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES in every checkpoint). Multiple implementations of ADR-009 and CanonicalEncoder (TASK-0004, TASK-0005, TASK-0006) reported all acceptance criteria passing, including compile, lint, boundary checks, and 167–171 tests passing, yet none was committed to the repository. The root cause of the acceptance failure is unknown to the Ideator and is a process-level issue, not a code quality issue. If this pattern continues, no FASE-1 acceptance criteria will ever be met regardless of implementation quality.

No DEFINIR item has been resolved by an ADR despite the explicit FASE-1 acceptance requirement for at minimum ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder specification) and the hash function ADR (ADR-002 DEFINIR). Until an ADR is committed, any implementation of those items lacks a normative specification and cannot be reviewed for correctness against the spec.
